notes_text: A 3D action platformer with separate Hero and Dark campaigns and different playable characters. Includes story levels and local multiplayer modes; published/developed by SEGA. The Steam version is dated 19 November 2012; Battle Mode DLC is a separate product and is not part of the frozen base-game identity.

source_log.observation: Steam confirms both campaigns, 3D platformer presentation, multiplayer, 2012 Steam listing and separately sold Battle Mode DLC.
